tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List the published mentor.energy courses for energy professionals (oil & gas, geoscience, engineering): title, description, discipline, level, duration, objectives and link.

tools.name: get_course_outline
tools.description: Get a course outline: its modules and lessons with type, duration, whether there is a video, whether the lesson is a free preview, and links.

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: Get a lesson. Free preview lessons return the full text and video links; other lessons return a short summary and a sign-in link (the full lesson needs a free mentor.energy account).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search mentor.energy courses, lesson titles and blog posts by keyword. Returns matches with links.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List published mentor.energy blog posts (career advice for energy professionals, industry insight), newest first.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Get the full text of a published mentor.energy blog post by slug.

tools.name: find_mentors
tools.description: Find verified, available mentors on mentor.energy, optionally by area of expertise. Returns name, role, company, years of experience, expertise and profile link.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
